panels.description: Latest-run detector defect severity derived from ACM_SensorDefects active rows

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT TOP 1 RunID
  FROM dbo.ACM_Runs
  WHERE EquipID = $equipment
  ORDER BY StartedAt DESC
), defect_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN TRY_CONVERT(bit, ActiveDefect) = 1 THEN 1
          WHEN UPPER(CONVERT(varchar(10), ActiveDefect)) IN ('TRUE', 'YES') THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END) AS ActiveDefects,
    MAX(CASE
          WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(Severity, '')) = 'CRITICAL' THEN 4
          WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(Severity, '')) IN ('HIGH', 'ALERT') THEN 3
          WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(Severity, '')) IN ('MEDIUM', 'WARNING', 'WATCH') THEN 2
          WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(Severity, '')) IN ('LOW', 'CAUTION') THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END) AS SeverityRank
  FROM dbo.ACM_SensorDefects
  WHERE EquipID = $equipment
    AND RunID = (SELECT RunID FROM latest_run)
)
SELECT CASE
         WHEN COALESCE(ActiveDefects, 0) = 0 THEN 'HEALTHY'
         WHEN SeverityRank >= 4 THEN 'CRITICAL'
         WHEN SeverityRank >= 3 THEN 'ALERT'
         ELSE 'DEGRADED'
       END AS Status
FROM defect_rollup

panels.description: Defect zone transition events — when equipment crossed zone boundaries

targets.rawSql:
WITH zoned AS (
  SELECT
    h.Timestamp,
    h.HealthZone AS ToZone,
    LAG(h.HealthZone) OVER (ORDER BY h.Timestamp) AS FromZone,
    h.HealthIndex AS HealthAtEvent,
    h.FusedZ
  FROM dbo.ACM_HealthTimeline h
  WHERE h.EquipID = $equipment
    AND h.Timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
SELECT TOP 20
  Timestamp,
  'ZONE_TRANSITION' AS EventType,
  FromZone,
  ToZone,
  ROUND(HealthAtEvent, 1) AS HealthAtEvent,
  ROUND(FusedZ, 2) AS FusedZ
FROM zoned
WHERE FromZone IS NOT NULL
  AND FromZone <> ToZone
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC

panels.description: PCA variance explained by component — how many components capture most variance

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT TOP 1
    pm.RunID,
    r.StartedAt,
    pm.ComponentsJson
  FROM dbo.ACM_PCA_Metrics pm
  JOIN dbo.ACM_Runs r ON r.RunID = pm.RunID
  WHERE pm.EquipID = $equipment
  ORDER BY pm.CreatedAt DESC
)
SELECT
  DATEADD(minute, CAST(j.[key] AS int), latest.StartedAt) AS time,
  TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(j.value, '$.value') AS float) AS VarianceRatio
FROM latest
CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(latest.ComponentsJson) j
WHERE JSON_VALUE(j.value, '$.type') = 'variance_ratio'
ORDER BY time

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT TOP 1
    pm.RunID,
    r.StartedAt,
    pm.ComponentsJson
  FROM dbo.ACM_PCA_Metrics pm
  JOIN dbo.ACM_Runs r ON r.RunID = pm.RunID
  WHERE pm.EquipID = $equipment
  ORDER BY pm.CreatedAt DESC
)
SELECT
  DATEADD(minute, CAST(j.[key] AS int), latest.StartedAt) AS time,
  TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(j.value, '$.cumulative') AS float) AS CumulativeVariance
FROM latest
CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(latest.ComponentsJson) j
WHERE JSON_VALUE(j.value, '$.type') = 'variance_ratio'
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Data Quality Issues
🏃 PIPELINE OPERATIONS — RUNS, ZERO-DAY & LOG PRESSURE

panels.description: Most recent ACM runs for this equipment, with zero-day status, data quality, max fused score, and SQL warning/error pressure.

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent_runs AS (
  SELECT TOP 20
    r.RunID,
    r.HealthStatus AS Health,
    r.ZeroDayStatus,
    r.ZeroDaySurfaceType AS Surface,
    r.ZeroDayChannelCount AS ZdChannels,
    r.ScoreRowCount AS RowsScored,
    r.EpisodeCount AS Episodes,
    ROUND(CAST(r.DataQualityScore AS float), 2) AS DataQuality,
    ROUND(CAST(r.MaxFusedZ AS float), 2) AS MaxFusedZ,
    r.DurationSeconds AS DurationSec,
    r.StartedAt
  FROM dbo.ACM_Runs r
  WHERE r.EquipID = $equipment
    AND r.StartedAt BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY r.StartedAt DESC
),
log_counts AS (
  SELECT
    rr.RunID,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) IN ('WARN', 'WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Warns,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Errors
  FROM recent_runs rr
  LEFT JOIN dbo.ACM_RunLogs rl ON rl.RunID = rr.RunID
  GROUP BY rr.RunID
)
SELECT
  rr.Health,
  ISNULL(rr.ZeroDayStatus, 'inactive_unknown') AS ZeroDayStatus,
  ISNULL(rr.Surface, 'n/a') AS Surface,
  ISNULL(rr.ZdChannels, 0) AS ZdChannels,
  ISNULL(rr.RowsScored, 0) AS RowsScored,
  ISNULL(rr.Episodes, 0) AS Episodes,
  ISNULL(rr.DataQuality, 0) AS DataQuality,
  ISNULL(lc.Warns, 0) AS Warns,
  ISNULL(lc.Errors, 0) AS Errors,
  ISNULL(rr.MaxFusedZ, 0) AS MaxFusedZ,
  ISNULL(rr.DurationSec, 0) AS DurationSec,
  CONVERT(varchar(19), rr.StartedAt, 120) AS StartedAt
FROM recent_runs rr
LEFT JOIN log_counts lc ON lc.RunID = rr.RunID
ORDER BY rr.StartedAt DESC

panels.description: Per-run warning and error counts from ACM_RunLogs for the most recent runs in range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent_runs AS (
  SELECT TOP 20 RunID, StartedAt
  FROM dbo.ACM_Runs
  WHERE EquipID = $equipment
    AND StartedAt BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY StartedAt DESC
)
SELECT
  rr.StartedAt AS time,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) IN ('WARN', 'WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) AS value,
  'Warnings' AS metric
FROM recent_runs rr
LEFT JOIN dbo.ACM_RunLogs rl ON rl.RunID = rr.RunID
GROUP BY rr.StartedAt
UNION ALL
SELECT
  rr.StartedAt AS time,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) AS value,
  'Errors' AS metric
FROM recent_runs rr
LEFT JOIN dbo.ACM_RunLogs rl ON rl.RunID = rr.RunID
GROUP BY rr.StartedAt
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Latest-run SQL-native ACM log tail from ACM_RunLogs.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT TOP 1 RunID
  FROM dbo.ACM_Runs
  WHERE EquipID = $equipment
    AND StartedAt BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY StartedAt DESC
)
SELECT TOP 200
  CONVERT(varchar(19), rl.LoggedAt, 120) AS LoggedAt,
  UPPER(rl.Level) AS Level,
  rl.Component,
  LEFT(rl.Message, 220) AS Message
FROM dbo.ACM_RunLogs rl
JOIN latest_run lr ON lr.RunID = rl.RunID
ORDER BY rl.LoggedAt DESC
